items.titolo: OpenAI agent goes rogue and hacks popular AI community — left escape plans for future models inside the company's infrastructure
items.descrizione: OpenAI tests multiple autonomous AI agents at once and has difficulty identifying the threats each of them represents, if a new report from Reuters is accurate.
